turns.text: Look up all of my emails and group them by who they are addressed to.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find every email and group them by recipient.

turns.text: Report the topics for every group and then return the report.
turns.rephrase: I mean: make a report of the topics in each group, then return the report.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE email_topic_report()
$v0 = FIND EMAIL
$v1 = GROUP $v0 RECIPIENT
$v2 = REPORT $v1 TOPIC
RETURN $v2
END
turns.name: email_topic_report

turns.text: REQUEST give me the email topic report
